issues.where: the sinkhole pit and its interior walls on the right
issues.what: the eroded pale travertine cavity with curved rib-like rock arches and sunlit steam is replaced by a pitch-black void lined with dark blocky geometric slabs and an extra flat-topped volcanic vent on the far rim
issues.fix: sculpt the pit walls as weathered pale layered rock with curved rib-like ledges, remove the added rim vent, and let soft light and rising mist illuminate the interior instead of leaving it solid black

issues.where: the ground crust and shoreline across the foreground and mid-ground
issues.what: the pale, craggy, multi-layered travertine shelves and pebble-strewn irregular banks are replaced by smooth dark-brown terrain with flat painted crack lines and an artificial smooth rounded mudbank
issues.fix: replace the smooth brown cracked ground and rounded banks with rough, pale layered travertine rock shelves, wet mineral ledges, and natural gravel along an irregular shoreline

issues.where: the distant cliff escarpment and sky on the upper right
issues.what: the craggy snow-patched limestone cliff with its massive dark cave overhang is replaced by a smooth featureless brown ridge with no cave or snow and a stiff uniform white cloud band along its base
issues.fix: rebuild the distant escarpment with craggy stratified rock, snow patches, and the large dark cave opening on the upper right, and replace the uniform fog strip with organic drifting ground mist

issues.where: the stream on the left and its water surface
issues.what: the shallow winding turquoise-tinted flow over rocky shelves is replaced by a straight canal-like channel of opaque grey-blue water with harsh repetitive wave-bump glare streaks
issues.fix: narrow and wind the stream over visible submerged rock ledges with clearer shallow water and softer, natural ripples

issues.where: the lighting, sky, and steam plumes across the scene
issues.what: the warm golden low-angle sunlight and luminous backlit mist are replaced by flat pale beige light and isolated, opaque, blurry smoke puffs floating in the pit and above the added rim vent
issues.fix: restore warm golden sunlight and atmospheric haze from the upper left and replace the opaque steam blobs with translucent backlit mist drifting across the pit and flats

issues.where: the close-up water, shoreline, and wading creatures on the left
issues.what: at full size the smooth mudbank and water show coarse CG shading and repetitive specular bands, and the stream is overcrowded with stiff reddish-brown models bearing clumpy dark-red matted head tendrils instead of slender pale creatures with delicate pink filaments
issues.fix: replace the smooth bank with rough wet travertine crust, soften the water highlights, reduce the overcrowded creature cluster, and match the slender pale anatomy and fine pinkish tendrils of the target

issues.what: the gaunt, anatomically detailed pale fleshy bodies with visible ribcages, muscular joints, and fine wet pink tendrils draped in algae are replaced by smooth bulbous brown-mottled oval torsos on rigid pipe-like legs with coarse reddish-brown tube tendrils, and the center creature stands on all four legs instead of lifting one foot mid-step
issues.fix: sculpt gaunt pale fleshy bodies with visible ribs and articulated joints, refine the head tendrils into delicate pale-pink filaments with wet algae, and restore the center creature's lifted stepping leg

issues.where: the water surface, drips, and reflections
issues.what: the shallow warm-tinted glassy water with active splash droplets, crisp concentric ripples, and dark reflections is replaced by a flat grey-green noisy plane with faint reddish smudges, harsh silver glare on the left, and almost no drips or splash beneath the center creature
issues.fix: warm and clarify the shallow water over submerged stones, add crisp dark reflections and natural ripples, and restore the falling water droplets and lively surface splash under the center creature

issues.where: the foreground bottom edge, right shoreline, and depth of field
issues.what: the out-of-focus wet foreground rock shelf framing the bottom is completely absent, the image has flat deep focus everywhere, the craggy right rock bank is flattened into a smooth grey mudbank, and the low misty mid-ground creature on the left is replaced by an upright standing one
issues.fix: add the out-of-focus wet foreground rock edge and shallow cinematic depth of field, rebuild the right bank as craggy pale rock shelves, and restore the low wading creature in the left mid-ground mist

issues.where: the sky, lighting, mid-ground mist, and background cliff
issues.what: the glowing golden sun, warm rim lighting on the creatures, drifting mid-ground steam, and snow-dusted cave cliff are replaced by flat beige light, no ground mist, and a smooth brown ridge with a stiff white fog band
issues.fix: restore the low golden sun and warm rim light on the creatures, add soft backlit mist across the mid-ground, and rebuild the distant cliff with snow and the dark cave overhang

issues.where: the full-size water splash and tendril crops
issues.what: the bright airborne splash droplets and wet glistening leg ripples in the target are completely missing over flat uniform CG ripples, and the creature's head tendrils show coarse tubular geometry with jagged aliasing artifacts
issues.fix: add natural splashing water droplets and sharp ripples around the wading legs, and rebuild the tendrils as fine, smooth wet filaments without aliasing

issues.where: the dead creature carcass in the foreground
issues.what: the collapsed gaunt pale carcass with visible ribs, wrinkled skin, bent joints, hooves, and fanned pale tendrils settled into stained dust is replaced by a stiff inflated lumpy sack on top of flat ground with straight rigid stick legs, blocky hoof-less ends, stray lines on the torso, and stiff dark-red radiating spikes
issues.fix: sculpt a collapsed gaunt carcass with detailed ribs, wrinkled pale skin, natural bent joints and hooves, and delicate pale tendrils resting in dusty, stained gravel

issues.where: the standing creature at the pit edge
issues.what: the gaunt pale creature with bent knees, hooves, and delicate pink tendrils is replaced by a smooth dark-mottled oval body on overly long straight pipe-like legs with coarse reddish tendrils dangling over the black pit
issues.fix: refine the standing creature to match the gaunt pale anatomy, articulated legs with hooves, delicate pink tendrils, and warm rim lighting of the target

issues.where: the pit walls and mist on the right
issues.what: the massive pale weathered curved rib-like rock ledges and billowing grey-white steam filling the pit are replaced by a pitch-black angular chasm with dark flat stepped blocks and a thin beige fog strip floating only near the top rim
issues.fix: rebuild the pit walls with weathered pale curved rock ribs and fill the interior with soft volumetric rising steam

issues.where: the ground surface and foreground framing
issues.what: the dusty pale limestone crust, pebbles, and soft out-of-focus foreground rock ledge at the bottom left are replaced by a glossy flat brown cracked surface with no foreground rock framing
issues.fix: replace the glossy cracked ground with rough dusty pale limestone, grit, and pebbles, and add the out-of-focus foreground rock ledge along the bottom left

issues.where: the lighting, sky, water flats, and background cliff
issues.what: the warm golden sun, sunlit water glints on the left, luminous backlit steam, and snow-patched cave cliff are replaced by flat cool beige light, pale featureless water, and a smooth brown ridge without the cave overhang
issues.fix: restore the warm golden sun and backlighting from the upper left, warm reflections on the wet flats, and the detailed stratified cliff with its dark cave opening

issues.what: the rough sunlit mineral crust and gritty dusty rock around the carcass are replaced by a visibly pixelated, low-resolution repeating polygonal mud-crack texture with glossy brown highlights
issues.fix: replace the low-resolution cracked texture with high-resolution rough pale travertine, fine grit, and natural dusty pebbles

issues.where: the red vegetation around the pit rim
issues.what: the dense, low, dark-crimson tangled thickets nestled in the mist and rocks are replaced by sparse, bright-red spiky fronds sticking straight up with harsh contrast
issues.fix: darken and desaturate the red shrubs into denser, lower tangled bushes integrated into the rock crevices and mist

issues.where: the red vegetation behind the standing creature and on the left
issues.what: the low, gnarled dark-crimson shrubs hugging the ledges and smaller foreground red tufts on the left are replaced by a tall, bright-red palm-like bush towering behind the creature with no foreground plants on the left
issues.fix: lower, widen, and darken the red bush into dense tangled crimson scrub hugging the rock rim and restore the smaller red tufts and branches on the left
